description: This file defines the EmployeeQualificationsController class within the OrangeHRM PIM module. It manages the pre-rendering setup for the employee qualifications view, including preparing Vue component properties with employee-specific language data and setting permissions based on employee attributes.

classes.name: EmployeeQualificationsController
classes.description: Controller class for managing the employee qualifications view, extending functionality for viewing employee data and permissions.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares Vue component properties with employee language data and sets permissions based on employee number. Handles missing employee number with a bad request response.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns a list of data group identifiers used to check permissions related to employee qualifications.
